summary: The {{destination}} rejected {{failures}} deliveries between {{first_time}} and {{last_time}} with "{{top_error}}". Affected orders include {{affected}}.
likely_cause: Errors in the 400 range mean the {{destination}} did not accept the request itself, most often an expired API key, a changed password or a field it no longer expects.
